JPMorgan CEO Dimon meets FM Sitharaman in India

Jamie Dimon, CEO of JPMorgan Chase, met with Indian Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman in India. The meeting occurred during a JPMorgan India investor conference. Dimon also stated that the US should not punish India and global markets over Russian oil.
